Social/user-field reports are missing from this shard. | Package-shard screening: many new/updated agent-related packages (PyPI/npm/crates/open‑VSX). Strong signals for popular VS Code agent extensions and OpenAI Codex CLI; multiple infra primitives (MCP, memory, sandbox, security) need corroboration and security review. Missing social/operator reports.
